task: Unified autoregressive framework that decouples visual encoding for multimodal understanding and visual generation in a single Transformer.
named_methods_or_inspirations: Janus (decoupled visual encoding; mentioned indirectly through doge.png Figure 5)
LLaVA (understanding branch: vision encoder + projector + LLM)
LlamaGen (vanilla autoregressive next-token-prediction for images using a VQ tokenizer)
non_negotiable_components: Two visual pathways: an UNDERSTANDING encoder (semantic, continuous features) and a GENERATION tokenizer (discrete VQ codes).
A single unified autoregressive Transformer trunk consumes BOTH pathways via a shared sequence/embedding space.
Next-token prediction objective handles text tokens AND image VQ tokens.
On the understanding side the encoder feeds a projector that maps to the LLM input space.
Demonstrate on the supplied equation.png (OCR / LaTeX) and doge.png (humor/semantic) probes.
deliverables: Side-by-side single vs decoupled encoder comparison
Understanding qualitative outputs on equation.png and doge.png
Text-to-image generation demo with VQ tokens
Quantitative ablation table (representation quality / generation quality / shared-encoder interference)
